test_title: PYST 204: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 29th Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the box that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ca9324c2a1f939d3b2b757e09b28e2221a5022183613ebb45cfa8e0876c6c53.png]
solution:
Opposite surface of the open dice can be found by the below method:-

 
• Alternate surfaces are opposite to each other.
 
• No two opposite surface are touched by side or by corners

So, by using the above rule we can find the opposite surface of open dice.

In the given figure, Opposite faces are :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18a64ecdbe0ba63d348b629b389466d12e0d55ca18ed29c5bda156bc2dc6e237.png] 

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17f88449ed09e28935a4c8fca67f7a6e3b23b4a9f73ffdcb02bbb24c1f5830c1.png] → Opposite faces are seen together so, this cube cannot be formed.

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3dd5ea9f966eb0eccb1ff35ebe541983c473282b8dd2296c2a64e9cc81f324ec.png] → Opposite faces are seen together so, this cube cannot be formed.

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efbaee006915234dfe586f73c285688d4b19a443585e1aa875ed01289f8b6bac.png] → None of the opposite faces are seen together nor they are adjacent to each other so, This cube can be formed.

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50cbbe521ade1ba641c2e464af5e2ef5688b3dbe2b3699c2c60dd0b54cc6bc41.png] → Opposite faces are seen together so, this cube cannot be formed.

Hence, the correct answer is** "option 3".**
